title: Find All Good Strings
description: Find the number of good strings that are lexicographically between s1 and s2 and do not contain evil string.
pseudocode:
1: memo = {}
2: function dfs(idx, tight1, tight2, kmpIdx)
3: if kmpIdx == evil.length: return 0
4: if idx == n: return 1
5: res = 0
6: start = tight1 ? s1[idx] : 'a'
7: end = tight2 ? s2[idx] : 'z'
8: for char c from start to end:
9:   newTight1 = tight1 && (c == start)
10:  newTight2 = tight2 && (c == end)
11:  newKmp = getNextKmp(kmpIdx, c)
12:  res += dfs(idx + 1, newTight1, newTight2, newKmp)
13: return res
